analysis_type: Passive records, exact cached float32 inputs, static geometry and sampling arithmetic; no new games or inference.
diagnosis: Seven closeup sources repeat the intent-legal but ineffective king assault macro, create no babies and starve. The eighth source escapes after dirt clearing but only supplies the opposite role/team pair to its predetermined reserve allocation. Existing evidence supports frozen-policy/action-abstraction deadlock, not lost collector states or altered engine physics.

recommendation.caveat: Temperature 1.0 improves exploration probability in cached states; coverage remains unproven until a bounded complete discovery stage meets every quota.
recommendation.change: Use symmetric source-game temperature 1.0 for both teams, all four maps, and training/validation discovery. Keep terminal continuation temperature 0.35.
recommendation.fresh_data: A new version and identity must regenerate the entire paired source/reserve inventory; do not reuse v5 caches or fit on the incomplete 24 roots.
preserve: terminal selection, validation and comparator protocol
recommendation.reason: Temperature 0.35 suppresses dirt-clearing exploration despite substantial raw policy mass outside assault. More identical-temperature reserves mostly repeat this deadlock; relaxing action37 alone cannot create baby roots.

reserve_j6.explanation: Even reserve j6 is assigned to the even j2 group. Its two available candidates form the odd group and cannot be reassigned after observing outcomes.

stalled_source_anchor_sample_statistics.interpretation: These are uniform reservoir samples, not all visited states. Temperature-1 action probabilities equal the cached legal-normalized prior. Temperature comparisons are arithmetic, not new game results.

starvation_explanation.interpretation: Official terminal deaths and a seeded official tie-break, not a watchdog or artificial terminal score.

static_geometry.interpretation: Even the relaxed wall-only king route cannot approach the enemy footprint within attack radius. Intent legality does not guarantee a route exists.
static_geometry.moves: 8-neighbor king-center graph requiring every tile of the 3x3 footprint on-map and wall-free.
